title: Verify qualified layout A adapter
preconditions: TALLY_INGEST_PRIVATE_FIXTURE_MANIFEST names the ignored production Layout A candidate and its external expected facts; PdfPig extraction is available. Date, transaction amount, running balance, row boundary, and controls remain exact. Description ownership has three reviewed states: one source candidate, zero source candidates, or multiple candidates.
steps: Load every candidate through PrivateStatementFixtureSet; extract PdfDocumentEvidence twice; run PdfTextLayoutAStatementAdapter probe. For each Layout A exact match, compare ordered records, exact financial facts, exclusions, controls, descriptionEvidenceKind, fixed absence-marker behavior, and deterministic safe digests. Exercise unique, zero, and multiple description-candidate rows synthetically. Run layout B and drifted evidence as negative probes.
expected: Exactly pdf-text-layout-a-v1 matches the production Layout A fixture. Unique description ownership emits source_text and normalized source text; zero candidates on a structurally complete row emits source_absent_marker and exact marker 'Description unavailable in source statement'; multiple candidates no-match. Every private date, movement, balance, control, identity, and non-absent description agrees twice, originalTextEvidence contains no generated marker, and no Ledger mutation occurs.
cleanup: Dispose immutable evidence and isolated test state; leave caller-owned fixture bytes unchanged.
